verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.photo_observation: Tracing the annotated run: PV modules on the rooftop (pages 10-11) feed into conduit pipes at a parapet corner captioned 'Conduit pipes for the DC cable' (page 11); the same conduit bundle is shown continuing down the building's exterior column (page 13, orange/green routing lines over visible conduit pipes) to ground level, terminating at labeled DC Earth Pit / LA Pit / AC Earth Pit markers (page 14); indoors, a 'Conduit' label marks cable entry into the tarped 'Inverter and Accessories' / 'Batteries' area (page 12) with a nearby 'UPS point' callout. The bundle size and pipe count look consistent across the exterior-run photos (pages 13-14) with no visible orphan/cut ends. The run does not reach an installed 'solar meter' or 'main panel' because none exists yet ('No Meter' per electrical_1), which is expected given the under-construction state rather than a documentation gap.
verdicts.rationale: The photographed segments (PV array → parapet conduit → exterior conduit run → earth pits / inverter room) form a visually continuous, appropriately sized conduit path with no orphan ends; the missing meter/main-panel segment is explained by the site having no meter installed yet, not by a break in the documented routing.
